entry.title: Likely: Apple launches OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros and an M6 lineup around Oct 27
entry.summary: Apple will announce OLED touchscreen 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros, an OLED iPad mini, a 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro and an M6 iMac on or around Oct 27, with a media day in Los Angeles on Oct 28.

entry.title: Likely: Standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e arrive in spring 2027
entry.summary: Apple is splitting its iPhone releases: Pro and foldable models in fall, the standard iPhone 18 and 18e in spring.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 family has four models, including a compact S27 Pro
entry.summary: Samsung will release the Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 Unpacked lands around Feb 24, 2027
entry.summary: Samsung will hold its Galaxy S27 Unpacked in late February 2027, possibly on Feb 24.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 parts ramp to mass production in mid-October
entry.summary: Some Galaxy S27 components entered mass production in September, with all four models ramping in mid-October.

entry.title: Shaky: NVIDIA RTX 50 Super cards debut at CES 2027
entry.summary: NVIDIA will launch the RTX 5060 Super (12GB), 5070 Super (18GB) and 5070 Ti/5080 Super (24GB) around CES 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: NVIDIA RTX 60 series slips to 2028
entry.summary: The next GeForce generation will miss 2027 and reach retail in 2028; AMD will have only one RDNA 5 GPU in 2027.

entry.title: Likely: Intel Nova Lake-S desktop CPUs debut at CES 2027
entry.summary: Intel will launch Core Ultra 400 'Nova Lake-S' desktop chips at CES 2027, with first retail models in Q1 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: AMD Zen 6 desktop chips show up at CES 2027
entry.summary: AMD's Zen 6 'Olympic Ridge' desktop CPUs will be revealed at CES 2027 with retail from March to June 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: OpenAI's first device is a screenless smart speaker with a camera
entry.summary: The first Jony Ive-designed OpenAI device is a hockey-puck-sized speaker with a camera and sensors, priced around $200-$300.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple unveils smart glasses at WWDC 2027
entry.summary: Apple will show privacy-focused smart glasses at WWDC 2027 and ship them in late 2027.

entry.title: Likely: PS6 and the next Xbox slip because of the memory shortage
entry.summary: Sony's PS6 and Microsoft's next Xbox (Project Helix) will launch later than planned because of high memory prices.

entry.title: Shaky: Tesla unveils Optimus V3 before the end of 2026
entry.summary: Tesla will publicly show its Optimus V3 humanoid robot in 2026.

entry.title: Confirmed: Honor Win 2 and Win 2 RT launch in October
entry.summary: Honor's Win 2 and Win 2 RT phones launch this month with 100W/90W charging and 10,000mAh+ batteries.

entry.title: Confirmed: OPPO Find X10 launches worldwide on Oct 21
entry.summary: OPPO's Find X10 goes on sale on Oct 21.

entry.title: Shaky: Claude 6 arrives around May 2027 and GPT-7 around Jul-Aug 2027
entry.summary: Anthropic's next flagship lands around May 2027 and OpenAI's around July-August 2027.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 Ultra may switch to Exynos 2700 because Snapdragon overheats
entry.summary: Samsung found the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 overheating in S27 Ultra testing and may use its own Exynos 2700 chip if Qualcomm doesn't fix it by mid-October.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27+ drops ultra-wideband (UWB)
entry.summary: The Galaxy S27+ may lose UWB, a feature Samsung has offered for years.

entry.title: Likely: Apple Intelligence fully launches in China with iOS 27.3 in December
entry.summary: After an October beta, Apple will roll out Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3 in December, without the new Siri, Image Playground or the newer Genmoji.

entry.title: Rumor: One UI 10 is Samsung's biggest software overhaul yet
entry.summary: Samsung's One UI 10 will be its biggest software overhaul yet, built around cross-app 'contextual flow', fewer menus and tighter device handoffs, possibly with paid tiers for heavy AI features.

entry.title: Debunked: NVIDIA has stopped making the RTX 5090
entry.summary: NVIDIA has halted production of the GeForce RTX 5090 and is redirecting the GB202 chip to its professional RTX Pro cards.

entry.title: Confirmed: Qualcomm launches two flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips
entry.summary: Qualcomm will unveil two Gen 6 flagship chips at Snapdragon Summit rather than one.

entry.title: Confirmed: Pixel 11 prices go up $100
entry.summary: Google's Pixel 11 would start at $899 and the Pro at $1,099, about $100 more than last year, after leaks of higher European prices.
